Definition: properly, to be bright, i.e. (by implication) beautiful
BiblicalUsage: Yâphâh means to be bright, to be beautiful. Jerusalem was decked with gold and silver and was exceeding beautiful and prospered into a kingdom, but when she trusted in that beauty and dressed herself for lovers, her fairness was in vain.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that beauty given by God is a gift, and beauty trusted instead of God is a snare.
